support_methods_subtitle: Taght y moddey coontryssagh s’goaill rish. Ta gagh coyrle cur argid jeeragh da lusaghey, hosting, as hardware test.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis t'eh ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi. As ny s'mish, ta'n 'website' oc cur zero raaidyn as zero access da firmwares obbree roimhe dy 'chur stiagh 'sy stayd bricked. Ta'n Cur-my-ner as y phrojekt Community Firmware ymmyrkey ny pieceyn: ta shin archiveaghey gagh ROM stock legacy, ymmyrkey y hardware eu dy h-automagh, as ymmyrkey y player eu dy slan.
support_story_1_headline: Nush ta'n luchd-obbree goll er, ta'n chomun steep up.
support_story_1_item_1: Rescue Players Broken: Ta scansh s'saghney cur stiagh ymmyd jeh'n aght s'neu-chrauee nagh brick hardware s'seose.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMyn Stock Archiveit: Co-chruinnaghey immeeaght jeh firmwares 'sy fabricagh t'er ny scughey.
support_story_1_item_3: Cross-Platform Native: Instrumentyn flash laghyn son macOS, Linux, as Windows myr-cheilley.
support_story_1_item_4: Intelligence Hardware: Detect board automagh son dy vod oo dagh ooilley traa y phackage cheart y gheddyn.
support_story_1_lead: Coadey dty urrys veih trappyn hardware silent as ath-ghooieyn brisht.
support_story_2_body: Ta ymmyd jeh software oifigagh Innioasis ry-akin ry-akin rish forumyn son ceaghleyn Google Drive er-dy-henney, shareyn cloud Baidu marroo, as coadanyn zip mystery gyn obbraghyn flashing. T'eh er n'yannoo reddyn ry-chlashtyn, ry-chlashtyn, ry-chlashtyn, lesh SHA-256 ry-chlashtyn, ry-chlashtyn, as ry-chlashtyn step-by-step. Ta ny coyrlyn eu directly cur stiagh ny downloads as hosting ta jannoo shoh 24 oor 'sy laa, 365 laa 'sy vleïn.
support_story_2_headline: Cha nel Google Drive brisht. Gyn obbyr guess. Firmware t'ayn.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN Direct High-Speed: Lught-reill s'leshtal, direct, cha nel ymmyd erbee jeh'n aght shoh ny lioaryn marroo.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Ghow fys er y traa t'eh ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.
support_story_2_item_3: Installaghyn Step-by-Step Guided: Ta cowreydyn soilshey ry-akin ry-akin trooid gagh press button.
support_story_2_item_4: Cooidjagh Illish: Localized laghyn ayns Bearlagh, Shiinagh, Gearmailtish, Spaainish, Frangish & Japanish.
support_story_2_lead: Infrastructure co-oibragh ard-speeid, verify, as t'ou uss ry-hoi ry-hoi.
support_story_3_body: Software factory stock t'eh ny s'cosoylagh rish ny t'eh ry-yannoo rish y hardware Y1 ny Y2. Va'n chommuuney ain currit da Rockbox, systemyn obbree custom lightweight, cliaghtey codec audiophile, as themeyn custom gys bea. Ta shin ceannagh ymmyd jeh hardware physical ass y phoosey dy phrowal, dy injeneyraghey ry-cheilley, as dy verify gagh staydys. Ta tastey Cur-my-ner cur argid da ny h-unnaneyn test shoh dy jeeragh as cur stiagh forsaghey firmware custom.
support_story_3_headline: As t'eh ry-akin dy vel y player Innioasis ry-akin.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox Un-Click: Cleaysh audiophile as themeyn custom s'inshley ayns secoondyn.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Cooidjagh: Feaysaghey battery, UI ny s'glenney, as tastey codec clashtynagh y traa t'ayn.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Ta shin jannoo test er reddyn physical ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% s'saor, pryssoonagh-first as cha nel ads ny s'saor.
support_story_3_lead: T'eh cur Rockbox, systemyn obbraghey aalin, as sarey audiophile.
support_story_4_body: Nush ta'n chompaney hardware goll er y gadget ec y jerrey, ta modellyn shennaghys goll er n'eiyrt. Innioasis cha nel eh cur tastey da Linux, cha nel changelogs glen, as cha nel ymmyd erbee jeh'n aght dy ghra rish tra ta'n install ry-hoi. Cur-my-ner t'ayn son nagh lhisagh ymmydeyryn passionate y thrown jeh'n 'player' ceaugh perfectly good. 100% jeh ny co-obbraghyn co-oibragh t'eh goll dy jeeragh son y 'instrument' shoh y choadey foshlit da dy chooilley ghooinney.
support_story_4_headline: Cur cooney dooin dy yannoo shen nagh vel Innioasis jannoo.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Ta slyst y ghlenney prowal ec y traa t'eh ry-gheddyn.
support_story_4_item_2: Tastey Linux 'sy Chiad Chlass: MediaTek ta flashaghey dy kiaralagh er distros Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Changelogs Transparent: Noteyn ry-hoi ry-hoi dy vod oo toiggal dy jeean cre'n aght ta'n aght ry-hoi.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Cooidjagh: Ta gagh coffee cur y archive foshlit as saor da ooilley.
support_story_4_lead: Cashtal firmware cummit ec y chomunaght ta cur dty innidyn magh ass ny landfills.
